title: Fierce Network: AI Helps Offset Broadband Labor Gap
summary: Shane Eleniak said broadband's biggest challenge is an aging workforce. Agentic AI boosts staff productivity and enables personalized services.
body_markdown:
Aug 05, 2026


3 min


# Fierce Network: AI Helps Offset Broadband Labor Gap


Shane Eleniak, chief product officer at Calix, speaks with Mitch Wagner of Fierce Network about how broadband operators' biggest constraint is demographics, not technology, as experienced workers are aging out faster than they can be replaced, and how agentic AI can serve as a force multiplier for existing staff while enabling providers to personalize services, support, and marketing for individual subscribers.


[Read the full article on Fierce Network](https://www.fierce-network.com/fierce-network-tv/calix-bets-agentic-ai-can-offset-broadbands-aging-workforce-engineers-head-exits)
